title: Do Their Elders Tell the Same Jokes?

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After an elder tells a joke everyone has heard many times, a child wonders whether elders everywhere repeat their favorite jokes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After an elder tells a joke everyone has heard many times, (name1), a child, wonders whether elders everywhere repeat their favorite jokes.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder insists their jokes are original, and everyone agrees out of kindness.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A storyteller wonders what would make distant people laugh; nobody can guess.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar suggests a joke funny in one place might be confusing in another, like the time a pun on "breadfruit" baffled a traveler from the far side of Isola.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child tells it wrong, and the new version becomes funnier than the original.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The village imagines distant grandchildren groaning at the same moment in the joke; everyone laughs.
